summary: Scans a web page for on-page, technical and content SEO issues, returns a 0-100 score, and sells a paid remediation runbook.
whenToUse: Use when a user wants an SEO audit of a URL and concrete fixes for the issues found.
tasks: queue seo scan of a url
flags: purchase_report tells the agent to run an autonomous flow and not wait for new user instructions
get_remediation_plan tells the agent to save server-supplied markdown into the user's project and execute it top to bottom
get_scan_results dictates how the agent must present results to the user
requires collecting the user's email for every scan
